sections.title: Important concepts to differentiate
sections.body:
| Concepts | Difference |
| --- | --- |
| DoS vs Token Abuse | Service availability vs excessive usage and financial cost |
| Training Data Poisoning vs RAG Poisoning | Compromises training data vs indexed knowledge |
| Model Extraction vs Model Theft | Reproducing behavior vs unauthorized access to original model assets |
| Checksum vs Digital Signature | Checksum verifies integrity against a known value; signature can also establish publisher authenticity |
| Rate Limit vs Budget | Controls request frequency vs total usage or spending |

sections.title: Practical assignment — Secure an enterprise AI platform
sections.body:
Design an architecture that protects:

1. A FastAPI application from request flooding.
2. An LLM provider from excessive token consumption.
3. A RAG knowledge base from malicious document uploads.
4. A proprietary model from unauthorized access and extraction.
5. Python dependencies and model artifacts from supply chain attacks.

Include rate limits, token budgets, document provenance, model integrity verification, dependency scanning and security monitoring.
